Meeting Time Planner

Find overlapping work hours across time zones.

Your time

Highlighted rows: the full meeting fits inside 09:00–17:00 in every zone. Offsets are fixed (no daylight saving).

📖 How to use

  1. Pick your UTC offset (default UTC+05:00).
  2. Add up to 4 other UTC offsets.
  3. Set the meeting length in minutes.
  4. Press Find slots — green rows work for everyone between 09:00 and 17:00.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why fixed offsets instead of real time zones?

They are fixed UTC offsets (UTC−05:00, UTC+05:30 and so on) with no daylight-saving rules, so the conversion is simple arithmetic: local time = your time + offset difference. That means it will be off by an hour for regions currently on DST.

What makes a slot highlighted?

A slot counts only if the whole meeting — from its start to start plus length — falls inside 09:00–17:00 for every zone, including yours.

Can I use fewer than 4 extra zones?

Yes — each of the four zone selectors has a 'None' option. Pick at least one.
